fonts.display: 'Aspekta', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Fasthand', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Charcoal
palette.role: Primary headings, high-emphasis text — the deepest ink against the warm white canvas, anchoring headlines at maximum contrast

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Body text, icon strokes, secondary headings — slightly lighter than Charcoal for body density where pure black feels too heavy

palette.name: Mid Ink
palette.role: Filled button background, dark UI surfaces, strong border emphasis — the primary action surface; charcoal-darker than body text for weight contrast against pills

palette.name: Steel
palette.role: Default border color, card edges, icon strokes at rest — the structural hairline that carries the entire layout; appears in 260 borderColor uses, making it the most-used stroke in the system

palette.name: Fog
palette.role: Muted secondary borders, low-emphasis dividers — a lighter hairline for de-emphasized structure

palette.name: Ash
palette.role: Card inner borders, subtle dividers inside containers — softer than Steel for nested elements

palette.name: Slate
palette.role: Disabled or inactive border state, decorative dividers — sits between Steel and Fog for tertiary structural lines

palette.name: Mist
palette.role: Subtle shadow contribution, light card shadow base — a desaturated mid-gray for soft elevation

palette.name: Silk
palette.role: Image borders, body content dividers, light surface separators — the lightest visible structural line, near-white with just enough definition

palette.name: Bone
palette.role: Page canvas, card surfaces, link border, light text on dark — the warm white foundation; every other neutral reads against this base

palette.name: Cream
palette.role: Secondary button fill, elevated surface tone, subtle hover state — one step warmer/lighter than Bone for nested surfaces
